question: What bodily afflictions are removed by this wheel-based visualization?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These results follow from the described visualization.
inference: This visualization removes signs of aging and all diseases.
uncertainties: The case ending of sarvavyādhivivarjitam differs from valīpalitanirmuktaḥ, suggesting possible agreement variation in the text.
